meta.name: Tuitui Cloud Docs Reference Migration v1.3.1
meta.description: Reference-style DNA extracted from the supplied cloud-document screenshot and applied to the existing cloud-docs information architecture.
source_references: 05_网站程序（电脑使用）/当前工作稿/Cloud Docs Redesign v5 AI Modes.html

primary.role: primary action, active navigation, links and focus

secondary.role: secondary text, metadata and supporting navigation

accent.role: selected state, soft action background and scope hint

neutral.usage: surface, workspace, subtle fill, divider, border, muted text, body text, title text

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; blue reserved for action and state

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
font_families.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: system sans, restrained weights, no decorative type

layout.grid_system: global rail -> product sidebar -> white main canvas
layout.max_content_width: 1200-1440px for directory pages; fluid for editor
layout.columns: sidebar + main; 2-4 card columns depending on module

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px border on controls and cards

elevation.depth_cues: surface contrast first, border second, shadow last

iconography.style: semantic linear icons with occasional filled status glyph
iconography.preferred_set: chat, team, assistant, project, square, contacts, cloud-doc, document, skill, drive, search

motion.entrance_pattern: fade or subtle slide for panels

components.button_style: 32px height, 8px radius, filled blue primary and neutral secondary
components.input_style: subtle gray fill, white focus surface, blue focus ring
components.card_style: white surface, 1px border, 10px radius, no static shadow
components.navigation_pattern: persistent global rail and product sidebar with blue soft active state
components.modal_style: opaque white centered panel with soft shadow
components.list_style: flat rows for files and dense metadata for resources
components.component_notes: single action blue; no gradients, no ornamental grids, no card-wall excess

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a clean desktop workbench with paper-like white surfaces
aesthetic.era_influence: modern Apple-like productivity UI and enterprise SaaS

visual_language.whitespace_usage: functional breathing room around dense information
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: navigation and page titles provide weight; content remains light
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive discovery from module to scope to object
visual_language.contrast_level: medium-high text contrast, low surface contrast

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy, active blue and grouping
composition.grouping_strategy: brand -> search -> nav -> page header -> tabs/filter -> content objects
composition.negative_space_role: separates work areas without isolating them into floating cards

imagery.photo_treatment: not used as a primary layer
imagery.graphic_elements: linear product icons, document type marks, avatars where identity matters
imagery.image_shape: small rounded thumbnails; no hero photography

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state what is missing and show one next action

overview.fallback_strategy: static CSS surfaces and state changes

background_effects.description: solid white and light-gray surfaces; no animated background

svg_animations.description: icons may be SVG but not animated

visual_effects.composite_notes: The reference's signature is restraint: white canvas, quiet gray workspace, a single blue action language, clear active states and very light depth. The migration preserves the existing cloud-document information architecture and changes only its visual treatment.
